rule.name: ScanPerCallOverFixedCollection
rule.message: This method scans every element of a field collection for one that matches its parameter, and it runs from a loop or from many call sites while the collection does not change after construction, so each call repeats the whole scan. Build an index once (a Map from the compared value to the element, filled where the field is filled) and look the parameter up in it.
